notes.title: Final Chapter: Wen Sanren Now Live
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The final chapter of "MeiQi 2024," Chapter 6: Wen Sanren, is now live. Thank you to all the players for your company and patience during the serial updates. We hope you enjoy this installment.

During the serial updates of this work, in addition to the story progression, we also made significant updates to the game's underlying system. For example, we added an important association reminder function: when you discover enough clues to merge associations, you will be prompted. I think this is very useful for new players. Another example is the addition of an experimental automatic association function, which allows players who don't particularly enjoy deduction to play "Sun MeiQi Case" smoothly.

If you enjoy my work, I hope you can recommend "MeiQi" Series to more players. With your support, I will continue to update, and we will see you in "MeiQi 2025"!

Q

notes.title: Chapter 3 "Bai Lian" is officially online
notes.notes:
The case is still developing. After entering the Chemical Department dormitory, Liu Qingchun inexplicably felt a strange sense of unease, as if something unseen was quietly surrounding him. In the following exploration, he will face the dual impact of reality and illusion.

Wen Sanren and Wang Zhiqiang are missing, and Li Shufu and Liu Yanhong are also nowhere to be found. And that woman named "White Lotus" - who was supposed to have died many years ago, has mysteriously reappeared in this place, seemingly hinting at something. The case is far more complex than it appears on the surface, and there seems to be a more terrifying truth hidden behind it.

Can Liu Qingchun, who has ventured into the Chemical Department dormitory alone, uncover this mystery, or will he become a sacrifice to unknown forces? The truth is about to be revealed.
